section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the present study, which uses confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) to evaluate the factor structure and construct validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a large sample of adults in Hong Kong. The study examines multiple BAS models and investigates associations between body appreciation, BMI, weight discrepancy, and self-esteem, with expectations of finding a two-dimensional factor structure and sex differences in body appreciation scores.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section describes the study design, rationale, and hypotheses for a single study conducted in Hong Kong.
